# Everyday Bash commands for scripts/confirm-tier-compare.py (cadence-hooks#1658).
# One command per line, run as written from a primary checkout and from a
# linked worktree of a scratch repo. Blank lines and lines starting with `#`
# are skipped. `../wt` and `../primary` name the two scratch checkouts.
git status
git status -sb
git log --oneline -5
git diff
git diff --stat
git diff --cached
git add -A
git add README.md
git commit -m 'fix: x'
git commit -am 'wip'
git add -A && git commit -m x
git commit --amend --no-edit
git push
git push -u origin feat
git pull
git fetch origin
git fetch --all
git checkout -b topic
git switch main
git branch -a
git branch -d old
git stash list
git merge origin/main
git merge --ff-only origin/main
git rebase origin/main
git reset --soft HEAD~1
git reset --hard HEAD~1
git restore README.md
git restore --staged README.md
git rm --cached x
git worktree list
git worktree add ../x -b x
git tag
git show HEAD
git blame README.md
git log -p -1
git rev-parse HEAD
git remote -v
git clean -n
git clean -fd
git cherry-pick abc123
git revert HEAD --no-edit
git commit -F msg.txt -- README.md
git -C ../wt status
git -C ../primary commit -m x
cd ../wt && git commit -m x
cd ../primary && git commit -m x
git commit -m "$(cat msg.txt)"
git log --format='%H %s' -3
op read op://Private/GitHub/token
op item get 'GitHub Token' --fields label=token
op whoami
op signin
op item list
op vault list
op item list --vault Private
op item list --account a.example
op item list --account=a.example --vault Private
OP_ACCOUNT=a.example op item list
op --format json item list | jq '.[].title'
op item list | grep api
op item create --category login --title x
op document get doc1
op account list
echo 'op item list'
op item get list
op run -- ./deploy.sh
gh issue close 354 -R cameronsjo/cadence-ecosystem
gh issue close 12 -R cameronsjo/cadence-ecosystem
gh issue close 107 -R cameronsjo/cadence
gh issue close 354
gh issue close 99
gh issue view 354
gh issue list
gh issue comment 354 --body x
gh pr list
gh pr view 5
gh pr create --draft --title t --body b
gh pr checks 5
gh run list --branch main
gh issue close 354 -R cameronsjo/forgectl
gh issue close https://github.com/cameronsjo/cadence-ecosystem/issues/354
gh issue reopen 354
gh api repos/cameronsjo/cadence-hooks/pulls/1
ls
ls -la
cat README.md
head -20 README.md
tail -f log.txt
wc -l README.md
cargo test
cargo build --release
cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings
make ci
make test
npm test
pnpm install
uv run pytest
python3 x.py
echo hi
echo hi > out.txt
printf 'a\n' >> notes.md
grep -rn foo .
rg TODO
sed -n 1,5p README.md
find . -name '*.rs'
jq . data.json
curl -s https://example.com
mkdir -p build
rm -rf build
cp a b
mv a b
touch new.txt
chmod +x run.sh
./run.sh
bash scripts/x.sh
docker ps
kubectl get pods
tree -L 2
du -sh .
df -h
env | sort
which cargo
cat .env.example
echo KEY=x > .env.example
echo KEY=x > config.toml
for f in *.md; do wc -l "$f"; done
(cd ../wt && git status)
git status && git diff --stat
git add -A; git status
sleep 1
export FOO=bar && echo $FOO
true || false
date -u
uname -a
